data.desc: Prelude Therapeutics is a leading precision oncology company developing innovative medicines in areas of high unmet need. Our pipeline features highly selective KAT6A degraders and JAK2V617F mutant selective inhibitors -- new approaches to clinically validated targets with transformative potential for patients. We are leveraging our expertise in targeted protein degradation to create and develop next generation degrader antibody conjugates (DACs) with novel payloads, including a first-in-class mCALR-targeted DAC. Our mission is to deliver practice-changing cancer medicines.
